title: What the twist sees of a three-manifold
claim: For the twelve signed one-bit edge laws of SIGNED-3D-20261029-001A on a closed orientable three-manifold M (ordered triangulation, normalization c (lambda^3/mu)^V lambda^(-T)), the counting laws give 1, 1, 2, h/2, h/2, h, 1 with h = |H^1(M; Z/2)|, and the twisted laws give D(M)/2, D(M)/2, (D(M) + h)/2 (twice) and D(M), where D(M) is the sum over a in H^1(M; Z/2) of (-1)^<a^3, [M]> (the twisted exponent sum_t x01 x12 x23 is the cup cube). The cubic form a -> a^3 is linear (Wu), so D(M) is h or 0; it equals 2 lk(beta a, beta a) mod 2, so D(M) = 0 exactly when the linking form takes the value 1/2 on an element of order 2 (cyclic H_1 = Z/n: D = 0 iff n = 2 mod 4). The twist is not a function of homology: RP^3 # RP^3 (D = 0) and S^3/Q_8 (D = 4) share H_1 = (Z/2)^2, and sampled triangulations with H_1 = (Z/2)^2 take both values while every counting law agrees. So signs and order let one bit per edge see exactly one bit beyond |H^1(M; Z/2)|.
failure_conditions: A sampled triangulation where a twisted state sum differs from D(M)/2 computed through the Bockstein.
A cocycle where the triple cup product and the Bockstein formula for a^3 disagree, or a pair of classes where a -> a^3 is not additive.
A sampled manifold with cyclic first homology Z/n whose twisted value contradicts the rule n = 2 mod 4.
foundation_claim_scope: The invariants of closed orientable three-manifolds defined by the signed one-bit edge laws of SIGNED-3D-20261029-001A, and what they detect.

validation.status: checked on 76 sampled ordered triangulations (nine homology types): triple cup product equals the Bockstein formula on every cocycle; linearity on every pair of classes; the twelve normalized state sums against the formulas; the cyclic linking-form rule; the (Z/2)^2 dichotomy with equal counting values; controls fire; proofs in proof.md (classical background cited); no human or external review
validation.novelty: classical throughout (twisted Z/2 Dijkgraaf-Witten, Wu, linking forms); local content: the identification of the census laws, checked
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-29.
